records.failureSummary: T-04 user repository and data store delivered and verified. The DATA_DIR persistence layer is in place: src/store/data-store.js publishes whole JSON documents with an atomic write-temp-then-fsync-then-rename sequence (0600 file mode, directory fsync for durability, temporary-file cleanup and re-throw on failure), validates every data file name at the trust boundary (plain name only, no separators, no dot prefix, length and NUL checks) and returns a fallback for missing, blank or corrupt files so start-up is never blocked. src/store/user-store.js is the user repository: it loads the whole dataset from DATA_DIR (users.json) at construction, indexes records by a lowercase-folded username_normalized key for case-insensitive lookup, indexes by id for existence checks (hasUserId / findById), rejects duplicates with USERNAME_TAKEN, rolls the in-memory state back and re-throws when the atomic write fails, and persists only the seven whitelisted record fields (id, username, username_normalized, password_algo, password_salt, password_hash, created_at) so a plaintext password field is dropped on both load and write. New in this run: the write path addUser now also rejects a record that carries no hashed credential material with VALIDATION_ERROR, so a caller can never persist a user whose only credential was a plaintext field; the load path intentionally stays tolerant so a hand-edited file cannot block start-up. No API contract changed: createUserStore, getUserStore, resetUserStore, USERS_FILE_NAME, USER_RECORD_FIELDS, normalizeUsername and the data-store exports keep their signatures. Verification: npm run typecheck exits 0 and node --test over the store suites, the AC-04 persistence suite and the register suites (including the AC-06 concurrency suite) ran 37 tests with 37 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, exit code 0. Remaining red tests in the repository are outside this slice: four AC-30 README documentation tests (README is still the workspace placeholder, owned by the docs slice) and seven login/auth tests AC-09 to AC-13 (login and token slices not yet implemented, POST /api/login and /api/tasks currently answer 404).
